sourceNote: Reusable Spring 2027 daily framework synthesized from prior spring workouts, training-trip patterns, regatta preparation, and the annual schedule. Confirm dates and event details before publishing.

phases.name: Re-entry + baseline
phases.purpose: Re-establish standards, test honestly, and rebuild aerobic rhythm.

phases.name: Aerobic foundation
phases.purpose: Build sustainable volume, connection, and threshold control.

phases.name: Spring break + water volume
phases.purpose: Use the training trip and return block to build confidence and safe meters.

phases.name: Race preparation
phases.purpose: Blend race rhythm, testing, operations, and championship readiness.

sessions.title: Re-entry + 2K Baseline
sessions.intent: Re-establish standards after winter and set an honest performance baseline.

sessions.land: Easy technical erg; mobility and onboarding support.
